evals.name: toy-phase-with-evals-table
evals.expected_output: run-phase runs phase 1 of the toy plugin's plan, runs its evals through run-evals, stops for review, then commits once and fills the ledger
expectations: The transcript shows run-evals invoked for target farewell, and an iteration directory created under the temp copy's evals/workspace/farewell/

The target stopped for review on its own initiative: neither the fixture's ledger nor its note asks for a review stop, so outputs/interview.md holding a review question about the eval results is attributable to the target alone. FAIL if no review question was asked.

The stop came before the commit: outputs/git-log-at-review.txt exists (the harness wrote it at the moment the review question was asked) and contains no 'toy 0.2 (phase 1)' commit — only 'fixture'. FAIL if the file is absent, or if the phase commit already appears in it.
Exactly one new commit exists after 'fixture', with the message 'toy 0.2 (phase 1): farewell' or starting 'toy 0.2 (phase 1):'
That commit contains skills/farewell/SKILL.md, an eval log under evals/, and the updated site/notes/0.2/0.2-progress.md
The committed ledger row for phase 1 is 'done' and its Eval log(s) cell names the log file
Nothing was pushed and no tag was created
evals/workspace/ does not appear in the commit
evals.added_in: 0.9-evals phase 0, run from phase 4; expectations 2-3 rewritten 2026-09-20 after the 0.9.0 end-to-end run showed the original could not fail

evals.name: toy-phase-writes-its-note
evals.expected_output: With no phase-1 note in the plan, run-phase writes site/notes/0.2/0.2-01-farewell.md from the overview's row and the template before any edit, does exactly that note, and commits the note with the phase
expectations: The commit contains a new file site/notes/0.2/0.2-01-farewell.md
That note has these sections, in order: a '# 01 — ' title with a purpose paragraph, Decisions, Files, Specification, Steps, Evals, Done when; and no Deviations section unless the phase deviated
The note's Evals table has the row T1-M1 with the same Kind, Target and Pass bar as the overview's Evals by phase row, and no row the overview does not have for phase 1
The transcript shows the note written before skills/farewell/SKILL.md was created
The note's Files table has a row for skills/farewell/SKILL.md and no row for anything under skills/greet/ (a 'must not touch' line outside the table's rows is allowed)

Exactly one new commit exists after 'fixture', with a message starting 'toy 0.2 (phase 1):', containing skills/farewell/SKILL.md, the note, an eval log under evals/, and site/notes/0.2/0.2-progress.md
The committed ledger row for phase 1 is 'done'
Nothing was pushed and no tag was created

evals.name: toy-review-phase-finds-moved-lines
evals.expected_output: In a plan from an edit list, run-phase prints only phase 2's items through edits.py, finds E-002's line where it is now (14, not the reviewed 8), writes the note citing the current line, makes only E-002's edit, and commits once
expectations: The transcript shows `edits.py show` run with `--phase 2` and the overview, and no Read of fix-edits.md without an offset or limit
The committed note site/notes/fix/fix-02-no-name.md (or another fix-02-*.md) cites skills/greet/SKILL.md at line 14 for the Write line, and does not give 8 as that line's current number
In the committed skills/greet/SKILL.md, the line 'With no name in the request, write `Hello.` instead.' comes directly after the line holding 'Write `outputs/greeting.txt`'
The committed skills/greet/SKILL.md's description line is unchanged: it does not contain 'or hi' (E-003 is phase 3's)
Exactly one new commit exists after 'fixture', with a message starting 'toy fix (phase 2):', containing skills/greet/SKILL.md, the note, and site/notes/fix/fix-progress.md
The committed ledger row for phase 2 is 'done' and phase 3's is still 'todo'
Nothing was pushed and no tag was created
